objective: Find outcome-blind candidate domains with success headroom for the RASE selector; if none passes the Opportunity Gate, form the final result that the current benchmark has no identifiable success space.

two_layer_outcome_policy.candidate_domain_features: pre-rollout only: source historical failure rate, progress/time, state/action representation, policy/suite/task metadata, predefined decision boundary
two_layer_outcome_policy.domain_classification_labels: allowed from inner development outcomes (confirmation + K5 + K3); outer validation set frozen and never read during mining
two_layer_outcome_policy.split: nested task/root split; outer folds freeze final validation tasks; inner folds only may tune miner thresholds and selector

domain_classes.all_candidates_fail: fallback fails and no other executable candidate succeeds
domain_classes.fallback_dominates: fallback succeeds and no non-fallback counterfactual winner
domain_classes.heterogeneous_winner: fallback fails but some other candidate succeeds

requirements: >=2 operators each unique/co-best on >=10% of roots
oracle-minus-best-fixed success point estimate >= 5pp with bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
all-fail rate must not dominate the headroom
opportunity_gate.baseline: best fixed operator of the domain; always-fallback reported separately; continue weakness is never a substitute for the strong baseline
opportunity_gate.multiplicity: multiplicity-aware reporting; exactly one primary domain preregistered before training

pilot_budget: 24 tasks x 3 decision times x K5, only for the single domain closest to the gate; expand to 48 tasks only if the pilot still satisfies the gate; else stop

decision_times.critical_dynamic: source first progress stall / low progress (<20%) or first collision; preregistered fallback: source.step.32

primary_metric: closed-loop success improvement vs best-fixed/always-fallback; paired task-bootstrap 95% CI; PASS only if CI lower bound > 0 and absolute gain >= 3pp

stop_rules.gate_fail: no more data, no bigger model; final result = checked domains lack success headroom
stop_rules.gate_pass_selector_fail: opportunity holds but observability/learning failed; exactly one preregistered feature/urgency ablation allowed
stop_rules.offline_pass_closedloop_fail: diagnose distribution shift / candidate execution bias; offline results alone never claim effectiveness

inputs.confirmation_v1: runs/rase_vnext/confirmation_v1/branches.jsonl (2 policies x step 8/16 x 5 ops x 5 reps)
